blocks.text: A pothole on an expressway is more than an inconvenience. At highway speed, it can damage a tire, throw a vehicle off its line, or force a sudden lane change in heavy traffic. Keeping a road safe starts with finding and fixing damage like this before it causes harm. The scale of that work is larger than most motorists realise. This year, crews have patched 6,811 potholes on the North Luzon Expressway and 5,529 on the Subic-Clark-Tarlac Expressway, more than 12,000 in total. Each repair means closing a lane, setting out cones, and working beside moving traffic. Potholes are a symptom. […]... Keep on reading: What it takes to keep an expressway safe
